title: SIR: Over 76,000 applications seeking inclusion rejected; net additions far lower than draft stage deletions
shows: The Chief Electoral Officer's office gave Karnataka's figures for applications received from 16 June to 23 September. Of 7,87,534 Form 6 applications, 7,08,110 were accepted and 76,176 rejected, against more than 80.62 lakh names left off the draft roll as shifted or absent. Of 58,475 Form 7 applications, 23,926 were accepted. The office had not yet released counts of voters found ineligible.
quote: However, the number of additions remains far lower than the more than 80.62 lakh names deleted after being categorised as shifted or absent.
